title: Post fight photo shoot
author: dachi
summary: Our second iteration - Tekkai 2.0 finished up 3rd in the National Sumo Championship in Tbilisi.
mediaAlt: The sumo robot on a green cutting mat.
content: We wrap up 2025-2026 robotics season with a heavily brused Tekkai 2.0 (we lost a rear-left wheel against the winning team and obviosly had to give the lost wheel to them as a remembering gift.
